source.name: Smart Agents for D365 Business Central

mapping.summary: Platform to build AI assistants using BC tables and APIs
claims: Unlimited AI assistants using any table, report or API as tools
Agents perform tasks: post invoice, reconcile bank, run aged-AR report, draft replies
Figures traceable to source BC records
Drafts overdue reminders with live aging and attached statement
Bank reconciliation and journal preparation for month-end
Runs picks, receipts and put-aways from chat
Reads inbound email and drafts replies with live BC status
Interactive charts inside BC from natural-language questions
Model choice per agent: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Mistral
EU-hosted Mistral option for data residency
No-code Agent Studio with templates, tools, policies, autonomy and rules
SDK: call agents from AL code (codeunit, page action, job)
Agents defined as JSON and shipped inside partner apps
Agents never exceed user permissions; every action logged
EU hosting, GDPR-aligned, DPA on request
Free starter credits; billed via AppSource or prepaid credits
